name: JoAi: Add Product Variation External Reference

title.en: Link a variation to an external article
title.de: Variante mit einem externen Artikel verknüpfen
title.es: Link a variation to an external article
title.fr: Link a variation to an external article
title.ro: Link a variation to an external article
title.it: Link a variation to an external article

description.en: Link a product variation to the article or item ID of the same item in an outside system such as a point-of-sale till, an ERP, a marketplace listing, or a supplier. External references let you find and reconcile the right variation even when the other system uses its own article numbers. Each external ID can be linked once per team and source.
description.de: Verknüpfe eine Produktvariante mit der Artikel- oder Positions-ID desselben Artikels in einem externen System wie einer Kasse, einem ERP, einem Marktplatz-Listing oder bei einem Lieferanten. Über externe Referenzen findest und ordnest du die richtige Variante zu, auch wenn das andere System eigene Artikelnummern verwendet. Jede externe ID kann pro Team und Quelle einmal verknüpft werden.
description.es: Link a product variation to the article or item ID of the same item in an outside system such as a point-of-sale till, an ERP, a marketplace listing, or a supplier. External references let you find and reconcile the right variation even when the other system uses its own article numbers. Each external ID can be linked once per team and source.

description.it: Link a product variation to the article or item ID of the same item in an outside system such as a point-of-sale till, an ERP, a marketplace listing, or a supplier. External references let you find and reconcile the right variation even when the other system uses its own article numbers. Each external ID can be linked once per team and source.

bot: Use this to connect a product variation to the article or item ID used by an outside system. Pass variationId, the source (pos, erp, marketplace, supplier, or other), and the externalId from that system. List products first to find the variation ID. An external ID can only be linked once per team and source.
